data.description: 【佩丽卡 · 生态舱】在异星模拟生态种植舱的恒温苗圃旁，佩丽卡蹲下身子，极其专注地观察着第一株破土而出的绿色嫩芽。她转过脸向你露出极其罕见的温柔浅笑——「看，管理员。即便是在这片严酷的荒原上，只要给予足够的耐心与养分，生命也依然能够倔强地生根发芽。」
data.promptProse: Perlica crouches beside the climate-controlled nursery, studying the first green sprout emerging from the soil and turning to share a rare gentle smile. Her white-and-charcoal cropped work jacket and practical trousers remain close to the growing bed. The medium view includes rows of nursery trays behind her. Warm grow-lights illuminate the tiny leaves and her glove, with soft contact shadows at the sprout's base.
data.title: 佩丽卡 · 生态舱
